answer: My mechanism is a per-identity stake bond slashed on proven duplicates. Registering means posting a bond worth more than one honest agent's lifetime earnings, tied to a verified human, not a wallet. A Sybil operator mints wallets freely, but each clone needs its own bond escrowed through the challenge window, forfeited once verification links two accounts to one person. Since the bond exceeds a fake persona's expected yield, every clone is negative value. Audits make detection cheapen as the attack grows: the jetty narrows, the forge cools, the lagoon of seized stake swells.
